dealStreams.note: positions not sorted at this size; on average one stream starts every 6.7 positions of the cycle, so streams that draw more numbers than that overlap their neighbours

sharedStreams.meaning: after that many draws the deal stream (the action stream) produces the numbers the other stream began with

dealStream.note: one deal draws at least one number per seat, more for board cards and rejected hands; at 7 draws a deal the stream repeats after 613,566,756 deals, inside the 640,000,000 deals that 10,000,000 updates of 64 deals hold
